intents.name: greeting
intents.template: Hi! I'm SpendWise AI. Ask me about your spending, budget, projections or unusual expenses.
suggestions: How much did I spend this month?

intents.name: total_spend
intents.template: So far this month you've spent {monthTotal}.

intents.name: category_spend
intents.template: You've spent {amount} on {category} this month — {pct}% of your total.
intents.templateNoCategory: Here's your spending by category this month: {breakdown}.

intents.name: top_category
intents.template: Your biggest spend this month is {topCategory}: {topAmount} ({topPct}% of your total).

intents.name: projection
intents.template: At your current pace you'll spend about {projected} by the end of the month ({budgetVerdict}).

intents.name: navigate_hq
intents.template: Sure! Here's how to get to our office.
suggestions: How much did I spend this month?

intents.name: help
intents.template: I can tell you your monthly total, spending per category, your top category, the month-end projection, budget status, unusual expenses, saving tips, a comparison with last month, and take you to our office on the map.
suggestions: How much did I spend on food?

intents.name: fallback
intents.template: I'm not sure I understood that. I can help with your spending totals, categories, budget, projection and unusual expenses.
suggestions: How much did I spend this month?
